metadata.description: CEH agent skills for the full software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: ceh-agent-coding-contract
plugins.description: CEH agent coding contract: autonomous execution mode and the five-step task workflow.

plugins.name: ceh-plan-build-review
plugins.description: CEH plan-build-review: the plan-driven development loop — plan a fullstack app (iteratively or all the way to MVP), implement from the plan, and review the implementation against it.

plugins.name: ceh-architecture
plugins.description: CEH architecture: stack-agnostic design moments — architecture decision records (ADRs) and domain modeling.

plugins.name: ceh-python-service
plugins.description: CEH Python service: FastAPI, asyncpg, PostgreSQL schema, Alembic migrations, uv, testing (unit/integration/system), observability, and security standards for web services.

plugins.name: ceh-python-library
plugins.description: CEH Python library: packaging and publishing, public API surface discipline, semantic versioning, uv environment, and pytest testing standards for distributable libraries (no web dependencies).

plugins.name: ceh-scaffolding
plugins.description: CEH scaffolding: per-project-type project setup — directory layout, initial config, and required .gitignore entries for Python libraries, Python services, web frontends, and fullstack web apps.

plugins.name: ceh-web-frontend
plugins.description: CEH web frontend: SvelteKit and React (Vite) conventions, Bun, TypeScript style, ESLint/Prettier, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, accessibility, and testing agents (unit/integration/system).

plugins.name: ceh-git-workflow
plugins.description: CEH Git workflow: commits, branching, PRs (with definition-of-done gate), merging, releases, code review, and dependency management.

plugins.name: ceh-ops
plugins.description: CEH ops: incident response, rollback, deploy pipeline, and CI agents (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

plugins.name: ceh-summarize-chat
plugins.description: CEH summarize chat: structured session summary for LLM handoff.

plugins.name: ceh-lessons-learned
plugins.description: CEH lessons learned: extract and record session retrospectives into LESSONS_LEARNED.md.

plugins.name: ceh-dev-tools
plugins.description: CEH developer tools: repository exploration, mapping, and codebase orientation agents.

plugins.name: ceh-blog
plugins.description: CEH blog: interview-driven blog post writing — from rough idea to publication-ready draft; repurpose finished posts for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TL;DR, and newsletters.

plugins.name: ceh-documentation
plugins.description: CEH documentation: write end-user and operator-facing documentation — user guides, getting-started guides, how-to manuals, operator runbooks, installation/configuration guides, administration manuals, and troubleshooting references; plus changelog and README maintenance agents.
